parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of lightweight plastic. It extends from the hinge to the ear.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain stability and comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge joint to fold or unfold the glasses for storage or wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of durable plastic. It connects to the frame via a hinge.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and secures the eyeglasses on the wearer’s head, ensuring a snug fit.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the hinge to allow folding and unfolding of the eyeglasses.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame Front)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame front of the eyeglasses, typically made of metal, holding the lenses and connecting both legs.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the lenses and provides the structural integrity of the eyeglasses, ensuring proper alignment and vision correction.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and rigid, serving as the central support structure for the entire eyeglass assembly.
